methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective cohort study with appropriate statistical methods including survival analysis and regression. Matching or stratification to control confounding not evident from abstract. Retrospective design introduces selection bias. Sample size and power assessment not specified.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Observational cohort study on clinical outcomes and associations. Maps to LoE 4 per Oxford CEBM. Descriptive findings with limited clinical intervention guidance.

reporting_quality.justification: Minimal disclosure of data availability, no pre-registration mentioned, limited details on missing data handling or statistical methods.

novelty_literature.justification: Confirmatory observational findings without novel mechanistic insights or unexpected clinical discoveries.

writing_presentation.justification: Adequate organization with room for improvement in precision and methodological detail.

chief_reviewer.rationale: Retrospective observational study with limited methodological rigor and incremental findings. Suitable for tier-4 journal with major revisions addressing bias mitigation and analytical transparency.
